name: opencode-webfetch-redirect-guard
description: OpenCode plugin that enhances the native webfetch tool with bounded, permission-respecting redirect resolution.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm && bun build src/v2-entry.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
